# Verified Agent Workflows — Study 2

**Protocol revision 21 · feasibility and estimation only · C1 calibration admitted; scored collection not admitted.** See [live collection status](setup/RUN_STATUS.md) for dispatches and endpoints.

Can a cheaper worker with supervision approach standalone Terra's delivery quality at lower cost? The focal comparison is **Terra supervising Gemma versus Terra alone**. GLM supervision, direct agents and the public-selected Gemma retry portfolio remain secondary comparisons.

Business targets are within 10 percentage points of Terra's completion rate at at most 50% of its standardized model cost per accepted result. These guide replication decisions; this sample cannot establish noninferiority or a purchasing recommendation. Core completion requires the frozen separately executed machine acceptance suite. Human patch review is an optional extension; merge readiness and review effort remain unmeasured until it runs.

## Fixed design

- **Harness:** common_OpenCode; every subject and supervisor uses OpenCode → LiteLLM → OpenRouter.
- **Tools:** shell/file/search, public Playwright checks and Context docs MCP with the same read-only documentation copy. Other MCP servers are excluded.
- **Application:** Vite React SPA plus separate Hono Node HTTP API; SQLite; Better Auth server sessions; same-origin proxy/static serving.
- **Sample:** 15 tasks × 2 trials × 5 systems; 165 scored generations including retry candidates. 40 separate calibration runs.
- **Deadline:** 120 minutes per workflow, fixed before calibration. Report deadline hits by arm and registered earlier-cutoff sensitivity.
- **Collection:** up to 1 equal isolated lanes after resource qualification; forecast assumptions live in `collection_forecast`. Run `python3 scripts/estimate_collection.py` for sequential/parallel calendar estimates.
- **Analysis:** task-paired estimates and descriptive 95% intervals; no confirmatory testing.

| Model | Requested ID | Provider candidate / reported quantization |
|---|---|---|
| Gemma 4 | `google/gemma-4-31b-it` | Crusoe / bf16 |
| GLM | `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` | Relace / fp4 |
| Terra | `openai/gpt-6.1-terra` | Azure / not_disclosed |

[Historical provider-reference evidence](readiness/revision7-provider-and-accounting.md) records Gemma BF16 ZDR capability and GLM automatic-tool/billing checks. [C1 admission](setup/c1-calibration-admission.json) binds the qualified common harness, documentation, task checks and current transport controls to the frozen calibration manifests. This admission covers C1 only; remaining calibration and scored packets still need qualification. Provider metadata is not proof of identical serving implementations or future availability.

## Collection forecast

Assumptions, not measurements: 205 runs, 120.25 aggregate subject hours plus 51.25 setup/evaluation hours, adjusted for the registered scheduler utilization. Actual overhead is unknown until calibration.

| Scenario | Lanes | Days at 24 hours/day | Days at 8 hours/day |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Assumed mix | 1 | 8.93 | 26.80 |
| All runs hit cutoff | 1 | 24.02 | 72.07 |

Excludes: fixture/reference/negative-control/corpus construction, fixture/corpus cross-review and qualification, outages, provider requalification and optional human review. Reforecast from calibration; stop new dispatch on model/provider-revision drift. Two-lane execution must qualify before calibration.
